sections.title: Core
sections.markdown:
**Class:** Zealot 4 / Psion (Egoist) 1 / Awakened Blade 3  
**Race:** Angel-Blooded Aasimar  
**Alignment:** Lawful Evil  
**Level:** 8

### Attributes

**Accepted live-thread correction, player26Oct2026:** Styke has a permanent **+1 inherent CON bonus from the ritual**, effective CON11. Modifier remains+0; this changes neither HP nor Fortitude. Record this accepted attribute delta only; no other unexported ritual event, prayer count, date, sacrifice result or reward is inferred.

| Ability | Score | Mod |
|---|---:|---:|
| STR | 14 | +2 |
| **DEX** | **20 base / 24 worn** | **+7** |
| CON | **11 (10 base +1 inherent ritual)** | +0 |
| INT | 14 | +2 |
| WIS | 10 | +0 |
| **CHA** | **17 base / 21 worn** | **+5** |

Level-8 ASI raises base DEX 19 → **20**. The **ACTUALLY equipped** +4 DEX belt raises DEX to24/+7, CHA +4 headband raises CHA to21/+5, and the Cloak of Resistance is actually **+3**. Also assumes +1 custom mithral chain shirt, +1 greatsword and Amulet of Natural Armor +1. **Mithral chain shirt Max DEX to AC is +6**, so DEX+7 improves initiative/Reflex/attack/CMD/Dex skills but does not add another AC or touch-AC point while the shirt is worn. **Default duty/travel footwear** is the actually delivered Boots of Striding and Springing: speed40ft (+10ft enhancement), 30ft only if removed for bed/bathing/private reasons or clearly not worn; no repeated dressing check in normal combat.

### Defenses and movement - standard Inner Eye

| Value | Total |
|---|---:|
| HP | **54 / 54** |
| AC | **24** |
| Touch | **18** |
| Flat-footed | **24 when Uncanny Dodge applies** |
| Initiative | **+10** |
| Speed | **40 ft** with normal worn Boots of Striding and Springing; 30 ft if off |
| BAB | **+7/+2** |
| CMB | **+12** |
| CMD | **26** |
| Fortitude | **+10** |
| Reflex | **+14** |
| Will | **+13** |

Static values assume **Stance of the Inner Eye**.

Stance of the Inner Eye at IL 8 gives +2 insight to AC, attack, weapon/maneuver damage where applicable, CMB, and all saves, plus +1d6 precision damage. It still does not add to CMD.

**Uncanny Dodge:** Styke is not caught flat-footed and retains his Dexterity bonus to AC against invisible attackers. This normally also prevents those two cases from switching off Inner Eye. It does not protect every effect that genuinely denies Dexterity, such as immobilization or a successful feint under the underlying rule.

**Angel-Blooded resistance:** electricity resistance 5.

HP progression: level-7 maximum 48 + fixed Awakened Blade d10 increment 6 = **54**.

sections.title: Awakened Blade 3
Reaktionen und Schaden
sections.markdown:
- Normally focused with Living Bastion: **10-ft melee reach**, including adjacent squares, with the greatsword. A normal approach can provoke when an opponent leaves a threatened10-ft square to enter the adjacent5-ft square; entering10-ft reach alone does not.
- Combat Reflexes with current DEX+7: **8 AoOs per round maximum**; actual spent count and independent provoking opportunities still limit this. No extra attack per square of one movement.
- Use full current attack profile for an AoO (baseline PA **+15**, then actual buffs/penalties), not an iterative penalty or Minute Hand's -2. An AoO is not a martial strike: it does not itself trigger Zeal or add Bilious/Fetch damage.
- Per normal PA hit in Inner Eye: **2d6+19 weapon +1d6 precision**, then actual GMW/Collision. Example only: GMW+2 plus Collision yields **2d6+25 +1d6 precision**. Confirmed x2 critical: **4d6+50 +1d6 precision**, before applicable DR once. No example casts a buff or rolls dice.
- Minute Hand, Reflected Blade and counters compete for actual swift/immediate economy. A maneuver remains expended until its actual recovery; reserve-known maneuvers are unavailable unless actually readied.
- Preserve normal/deep focus separately; reaching a reaction does not authorize spending a player resource.

Minor Metamorphosis menu provenance: Dreamscarred Press text reprinted in [Book of Beyond — Liminal Power, p.69](Regelreferenz). Temporal Body Adjustment: Dreamscarred Press, Path of War Expanded, maneuver of that name. Existing campaign conversions remain authoritative.

sections.title: Maneuvers
sections.markdown:
**Initiator Level:** **8**  
**Initiation modifier:** CHA +5  
**Known:** **10**  
**Readied:** **6**  
**Ordinary stances known:** 2, plus Stance of the Inner Eye from Awakened Blade.

A normal 10-minute maneuver-preparation period may change the readied selection among the known list.

### Standard readied

1. **Temporal Body Adjustment**.
2. **Reflected Blade Style**.
3. **Minute Hand**.
4. **Circle of Razor Feathers**.
5. **Fetch's Wrath**.
6. **Bilious Strike**.

### Complete known list

- Rapid Strike.
- Minute Hand.
- Obsidian Sidestep.
- Reflected Blade Style.
- Strength of Hell.
- Flash of Insight.
- Temporal Body Adjustment.
- Fetch's Wrath.
- Circle of Razor Feathers.
- **Bilious Strike**.

Lifeburst Strike, Chains of Doubt, Vengeful Riposte, Ravaging Blow and Staunching Strike are not known in this level-8 build.

### Temporal Body Adjustment

Riven Hourglass 4 counter.

- **Immediate action**, personal, instantaneous.
- Initiate when Styke would be affected by, or is currently affected by, a qualifying negative condition.
- Ignore one incoming negative condition or end one current negative condition (including curse, dazed, paralyzed or sickened); no check or automatic HP restoration. One condition per initiation, not every condition from an attack.
- Cannot negate death.
- Expends the maneuver and consumes normal immediate/swift economy.

### Reflected Blade Style

Shattered Mirror 3 boost.

- **Swift action**, personal, 1 round.
- Next eligible standard-action strike targeting one creature also affects one additional opponent within **45 ft**.
- If the strike uses an attack roll, compare the same raw attack roll to both targets.
- Target-specific modifiers/defenses remain separate.

### Minute Hand

Riven Hourglass 1 boost.

- **Swift action**.
- One extra melee attack at -2 from the otherwise-current attack profile.
- Standard PA/Inner Eye result: **+13, 2d6+19 +1d6 precision**.

### Circle of Razor Feathers

Black Seraph 4 [evil] strike.

- **Standard action**.
- **30-ft-radius burst centered on Styke**; enemies in the area.
- **8d6 profane damage**.
- Reflex **DC 21** partial with the adapted greatsword (base DC19 = 10 + maneuver level4 + CHA5; +2 discipline-weapon competence bonus).
- Failed save: full damage and sickened **5 rounds**.
- Successful save: half damage and sickened **1 round**.
- Weapon Group Adaptation makes the Heavy Blades greatsword associated with Black Seraph; the +2 competence save-DC bonus is included above.

### Fetch's Wrath

Shattered Mirror 4 strike [teleportation].

- **Standard action**; self and one creature.
- Current medium teleport range at IL 8: **180 ft**.
- Either teleport then make one melee attack, or make one melee attack then teleport.
- Hit deals normal weapon damage **+4d6**.
- Standard PA/Inner Eye hit: **+15, 2d6+19 +4d6 +1d6 precision**.

**Reflected Blade Style + Fetch's Wrath:** perform Fetch's teleport once. Compare Reflected Blade Style's same raw attack roll against the secondary opponent within 45 ft. Each target actually hit takes the full Fetch attack damage; no second teleport is generated.

### Bilious Strike - new standard readied

Black Seraph 4 [evil] strike.

- **Standard action**; one melee attack.
- On hit: normal weapon damage **+6d6 profane**.
- **Campaign nerf:** Fortitude **DC 21**.
- **Failed save:** target is **nauseated for a number of rounds equal to Styke's current initiation modifier**. Current worn CHA21 gives initiation modifier **+5**, so the current duration is **5 rounds**.
- **Successful save:** target is **sickened for 1 round**, not nauseated.
- The +6d6 profane damage applies on either save result.
- Weapon Group Adaptation: Heavy Blades supplies the included +2 competence save-DC bonus with the adapted greatsword.



### Rapid Strike - known reserve

Riven Hourglass 2 strike.

- **Standard action**.
- Two separately rolled melee attacks against the same creature.
- Each hit deals normal current weapon damage.

### Obsidian Sidestep - known reserve

Shattered Mirror 2 counter.

- **Immediate action** before the saving throw it replaces.
- Replace that save with **Craft (Weapons) +9** against the same DC under the accepted campaign conversion.

### Strength of Hell - known reserve

Black Seraph 1 boost.

- **Swift action**, 1 round.
- +2 profane attack and +1d6 damage on Styke's attacks.
- -2 AC for the same duration.

### Flash of Insight - known reserve

Sleeping Goddess 1 augmented boost.

- **Swift action** after Styke succeeds on an attack roll or combat-maneuver check.
- One ally within 30 ft affected by a qualifying ongoing effect gets another save.
- Optional PP adds +1 insight to that save per PP.
- Optional focus augment may add a second ally.
- Never spend PP/focus automatically.

### The Caged Sun

Radiant Dawn 1 stance; emergency standard investment 2 Essence.

- cannot heal other creatures through Styke's own healing effects;
- +2 attack, AC, saves, CMB, and campaign-cached CMD;
- received healing **floor((incoming +4) x1.5)**;
- excess self-generated healing becomes temp HP under stance rules, capped at current max HP **54**;
- enter as swift, or free action at **27 HP or fewer**.

### Black Seraph's Glare

Black Seraph 1 stance.

- when Styke damages a foe with an attack, he may make the stance's free-action demoralize attempt with +4 profane under the cached published rule.

sections.title: Kräfte · Grad 1 und 2
sections.markdown:
#### Minor Metamorphosis

- 1 PP, standard, personal, **3 minutes** at ML 3.
- Base1PP: choose **one** option from either menu below, not one from each.
- Enhancement Menu A: +2 enhancement STR, DEX or CON; one size larger (+2 size STR/-2 DEX) or smaller (+2 size DEX/-2 STR), with actual attack/AC/CMB/CMD/weapon-size/reach changes; or +10ft base land speed.
- Ability Menu A: 5tempHP; Cleave; Improved Trip; +1natural armor; one slam/claw/bite (Medium1d8/Large1d10); resistance5 to acid/cold/electricity/fire; swim20ft; climb20ft; burrow15ft.
- Same choice cannot be selected twice. Enhancement ability bonuses do not stack with the same bonus type from gear (DEX+2 does not improve worn DEX+4 belt).
- At ML 3 the **+2 PP augment is now legal** for a total 3 PP, granting its additional Enhancement Menu A and Ability Menu A choices in addition to the base selection.
- Never assume a specific metamorphosis package without player declaration.

#### Defensive Precognition

- 1 PP, standard, personal, **3 minutes**.
- +1 insight AC and saves.
- Does not stack with Inner Eye's insight bonuses; useful mainly when Inner Eye is unavailable.

#### Offensive Precognition

- 1 PP, standard, personal, **3 minutes**.
- +1 insight attack rolls.
- Does not stack with Inner Eye's insight attack bonus.

#### Force Screen

- 1 PP, standard, personal, **3 minutes**.
- +4 shield bonus to AC; applies against incorporeal touch attacks as a force effect.
- Standard Inner Eye profile with Force Screen: **AC 28**; ordinary touch remains18, constrained by mithral-shirt Max DEX +6.

#### Call to Mind

- 1 PP; manifestation time **1 minute**.
- After failing a Knowledge check, immediately retry that check with **+4 competence**.
- Current Knowledge (All) retry is +17 before any legal Zorn assistance.
- Usually an investigation/research tool rather than an initiative action.

#### Chameleon - new

- Egoist 2; **3 PP**; standard; personal; **30 minutes**.
- +10 enhancement bonus on Stealth.
- Current result: **Stealth +28**.
- ML 3 cannot afford its +2 PP augment.

#### Energy Adaptation, Specified - new

- Psion/Wilder 2; **3 PP**; standard; personal; **30 minutes**.
- Resistance **10** against Styke's current active energy type.
- The resistance does not stack with other energy resistance; use the best applicable value.
- For electricity, this therefore supersedes the racial electricity resistance 5 while active.
- The +4 PP immediate-action augment is not legal at ML 3.

sections.title: Talente · Grad 0
sections.markdown:

- routine safe noncombat refresh remains the campaign convention.

### Combat / recurring spell quick cards

- **Obscuring Mist:** standard, V/S; stationary 20-ft-radius spread, 20 ft high, initially around Vesper; **8 minutes**, dismissible; no save/SR. Within fog, sight (including darkvision) is obscured beyond 5 ft: at 5 ft concealment 20%, farther total concealment 50% and no visual target location. Wind 11+ mph clears in 4 rounds; 21+ mph in 1. Fireball/Flame Strike clear their affected area; Wall of Fire clears its damage area. Does not work underwater.
- **Protection from Evil:** standard, V/S/M-or-DF; touch; **8 minutes**, dismissible; Will DC18 negates (harmless), SR no except contact ward. Against evil sources: +2 deflection AC/+2 resistance saves (not added atop a better cloak bonus); another save against existing possession/mental control at original DC with +2 morale, suppressing it on success, and protection against new control during duration. Blocks bodily contact by evil summoned creatures unless their SR defeats the ward; non-evil summons are unaffected. Attacking/forcing the barrier against a blocked summon ends that contact protection.
- **Air Bubble:** standard, S/M-or-DF; touch one creature or object no larger than a Large two-handed weapon; **8 minutes**; Will DC18 negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless). Breathable air at the head for underwater/airless conditions, or protects the touched object from water. Not a card granting immunity to magical poison.
- **Remove Sickness:** standard, V/S; one creature within **45 ft**; **80 minutes**; Fort DC18 negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless). Grants +4 morale on saves against disease, nausea and sickened; suppresses an already affecting one of those effects for its duration, rather than curing it or granting general poison immunity. Morale bonuses to the same save do not stack.
- **Endure Elements:** standard; touch; **24 hours**; environmental heat/cold comfort only, not energy resistance.
- **Cure Light Wounds:** standard, V/S; touch; instantaneous; heals **1d8+5** living target (CL cap included), capped at its max HP unless a specific ability converts excess. Against undead: melee touch **+6**, Will **DC18** half, SR yes; positive energy damages instead. Will/SR harmless for living recipients.
- **Unnatural Lust:** standard, V/S; one creature within **45 ft**; **1 round**; Will **DC18** negates, SR yes; emotion/mind-affecting compulsion. Designated creature/object must also be within range and perceptible to the target. On its next turn the target approaches and kisses/caresses that subject, taking no other actions; +4 save if it would not normally desire that subject. Retains the campaign's established level-1 access.
- **Identify:** 60-ft cone; **24 rounds**; detect-magic function plus +10 enhancement Spellcraft for possessed magic items under normal limits.
- **Silence:** **1-round casting**, V/S; long **720 ft**; **20-ft-radius emanation**, **8 rounds**, dismissible. Center on creature, object or fixed point; mobile carriers move the area. Unwilling creature/attended object: Will **DC19** negates and SR applies; fixed point/unattended object: neither. Occupants do not each save against an already established area. Blocks sound crossing the area and verbal spell components, and protects occupants against sonic/language-based effects.
- **Lesser Restoration:** **3-round casting**, V/S; touch; instantaneous; Will DC19 negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless). Dispel magical ability penalty OR restore **1d4 damage to one ability**; also removes fatigue or reduces exhaustion to fatigue. Does not restore ability drain or negative levels.
- **Undetectable Alignment:** standard; close 45 ft; **24 hours**.
- **Cure Moderate Wounds:** standard, V/S; touch; instantaneous; heals **2d8+8** living target (CL cap included), capped at its max HP unless a specific ability converts excess. Against undead: melee touch **+6**, Will **DC19** half, SR yes; positive energy damages instead. Will/SR harmless for living recipients.
- **Tongues:** touch; **80 minutes**.
- **Delay Poison, Communal:** standard, V/S/DF; creatures touched; divide **8 hours in 1-hour increments**. Fort DC20 negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless). Existing and newly encountered poison is postponed until protection expires; damage already done is not healed. Stinking Cloud is poison, but its fog still blocks unprotected sight. Record allocated expiry per recipient.
- **Dispel Magic:** standard, V/S; **180 ft**; instantaneous; no save/SR. **1d20+8 vs 11 + effect CL**. Targeting a creature/object: compare ONE result to effects from highest CL downward; end at most ONE spell. Alternatively name one particular ongoing spell, including an area cloud, and test only that effect. A CL8 cloud requires DC19. A magic item is suppressed for **1d4 rounds**, not destroyed. Own spells dispel automatically. Counterspelling is a readied interruption of a spell being cast with a dispel check; removing an already active cloud on one's ordinary turn is targeted dispelling, not a counterspell.
- **Cure Serious Wounds:** standard, V/S; touch; instantaneous; heals **3d8+8** living target (CL cap included), capped at its max HP unless a specific ability converts excess. Against undead: melee touch **+6**, Will **DC20** half, SR yes; positive energy damages instead. Will/SR harmless for living recipients.
- **Locate Object:** long 720 ft; **8 minutes**.
- **Freedom of Movement:** standard, V/S/M/DF; self or touched creature; **80 minutes**; Will DC21 negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless). Normal movement/attacks despite magic such as paralysis, Solid Fog, Slow and Web. Grapple checks against the subject automatically fail; subject automatically succeeds on checks to escape grapple/pin. Normal held-weapon movement/attacks underwater, but no water breathing. Does not remove nausea or grant sight through fog.
- **Cure Critical Wounds:** standard, V/S; touch; instantaneous; heals **4d8+8** living target (CL cap included), capped at its max HP unless a specific ability converts excess. Against undead: melee touch **+6**, Will **DC21** half, SR yes; positive energy damages instead. Will/SR harmless for living recipients.
- **Legend Lore:** noncombat divination; personal; casting time depends on how directly the legendary subject is available/known and uses its normal expensive material/focus components. It does not turn nonlegendary subjects into valid targets.

sections.title: Arcane Enlightenment
sections.markdown:
Seven daily-flexible selections: Alarm, Glitterdust, Silent Image, Heroism, Ashen Path, Stinking Cloud, Greater Magic Weapon. Heroism (Sorcerer/Wizard3) REPLACES Euphoric Cloud in the standing default; it is not an eighth spell. These spells are not permanent Oracle spells known. Apply this default at a lawful daily selection; no retroactive scene rewrite, spell activation, new day or slot refresh follows merely from this OOC instruction. Preserve already accepted current-day casts/effects.


Daily-flexible, not permanent Oracle spells known.

With current effective CHA **24 / modifier +7**, the established campaign selection count is **7**.

### Standing default seven — player-approved26Oct2026

1. **Alarm**.
2. **Glitterdust**.
3. Silent Image.
4. **Heroism**.
5. Ashen Path.
6. Stinking Cloud.
7. **Greater Magic Weapon**.

The standing default contains exactly seven spells. Heroism replaces Euphoric Cloud; daily reselection still follows lawful rest, without retroactively changing accepted earlier casts.

The daily list may legally change.  Other high-priority level-8 toolbox choices already planned include Dimension Door, Detect Scrying, Scrying when its focus is available, Locate Creature, and Stone Shape.

Current values:

- **Alarm:** standard, V/S/F-or-DF; point within **45 ft**; 20-ft-radius emanation; **16 hours**, dismissible; no save/SR. Tiny or larger creature entering/touching area triggers unless using the chosen password. Mental alarm reaches Vesper within 1 mile; audible alarm is normally heard at 60 ft. Ethereal/astral creatures do not trigger it.
- **Glitterdust:** standard, V/S/M; **180 ft**, **10-ft-radius spread**, all creatures/objects including allies; **8 rounds**, SR no. Will **DC19** negates blindness only. Blinded targets repeat Will at the **end of each own turn**, ending blindness on success; dust stays for the spell duration regardless, outlines invisible targets and gives **-40 Stealth**. Dust is not a persistent blinding zone for later entrants.
- **Silent Image:** standard, V/S/F; **720 ft**; visual figment within **twelve 10-ft cubes**; concentration (standard each subsequent turn); Will **DC18** disbelief upon interaction, SR no. Visual only: no sound, smell, heat or physical obstruction. Can move image within effect-size limits; does not create real terrain or damage.
- **Heroism:** standard, V/S; touch one creature; Will DC20 negates (harmless), SR yes (harmless), mind-affecting; **80 minutes** at CL8; +2 morale to attack rolls, saving throws and skill checks. Not damage or ability checks. Does not stack with other morale bonuses to the same statistic (use the higher bonus; Zeal+1 does not add to Heroism+2). No automatic cast or slot expenditure.
- **Ashen Path:** standard, V/S; living creature(s) touched; no save/SR; **80 minutes**, divided equally if multiple recipients (minimum **10 minutes each**). Up to **six willing targets as part of this casting**, all touched in the same round; legal movement can bring them within touch reach without a separate full-round touch action. Example: Vesper + Styke + Valeria = **26 minutes 40 seconds each**, one spell slot, provided the declared route reaches both allies. This is an example, not an automatic cast or positional change. No ill effects from natural airborne ash/spores/smoke/dust; **+4 saves against magical contaminants**, not blanket poison immunity. Sees through qualifying magical fog/smoke/ash concealment to **60 ft**; no added darkvision or light. Its +4 does not erase the need for a Stinking Cloud save.
- **Stinking Cloud:** standard, V/S/M; origin within **180 ft**; **20-ft-radius spread, 20 ft high**; **8 rounds**; Fort **DC20** negates nausea, **SR no**, **poison**. Living occupants save on exposure; those who saved but remain roll again **on Vesper's turn each round**, not automatically on their own turns. Failure: nauseated while inside, then **1d4+1 rounds after leaving**, rolled separately per affected creature when due. No fresh saving throw each round to cure established nausea. Fog affects allies and enemies: at 5 ft concealment20%, beyond5ft total concealment50%/no visual targeting; darkvision does not pierce it. Poison immunity/protection does not remove fog. Wind11+mph clears in4rounds,21+mph in1; no underwater use.
- **Greater Magic Weapon:** standard, V/S/M-or-DF; **45 ft**; **8 hours**; Will DC20 negates (harmless, object), SR yes (harmless, object). One weapon or up to50 matching projectiles held together. At CL8, **+2 enhancement** replaces an existing +1: **+1 net attack/+1 net damage**, not +2 on top. This temporary enhancement bypasses only DR/magic, not special-material/alignment DR by enhancement level. Each party sword requires its own cast.

sections.title: Zauber und Glyphen anwenden
sections.markdown:

- **Armaments:** the accepted stance and recipients determine effects at the actual point of a hit. Leaving the **50-ft** range loses the grant; re-entering restores it while otherwise eligible. No retroactive Collision or Conductive on an earlier out-of-range attack.

sections.title: Martial Training III - Radiant Dawn at level 8
Virtual Animus Adept rank 4
sections.markdown:
Campaign virtual rank **4**. This conversion advances Vesper's established glyph engine/rank features; it does not independently grant the prestige class's separate maneuver/stance progression beyond her campaign Martial Training track.

Operational values:

- initial Animus on first own turn: **8**;
- +1 at start of each later own turn;
- +1 at round end if Vesper initiated at least one maneuver that round;
- glyph cost 1 Animus;
- range **50 ft**;
- duration **8 rounds** unless the glyph ends earlier;
- glyph save DC **22** where relevant;
- cast as swift, or once/round as free after Vesper hits with a martial strike;
- same glyph does not stack or refresh itself.

### Mass Martial Glyphs - new rank-4 feature

- **Full-round action**.
- Cast one known martial glyph on up to **7 allies within 30 ft** (IM +7).
- Normal glyph cost/application rules apply through this rank feature as established.

### Known glyphs — 14

Retained basic glyphs:

1. **Elemental Shield:** energy resistance **11** to Vesper's active element/energy.
2. **Ghost Eating Blade:** target weapons gain ghost touch.
3. **Ghost Armor:** target armor/shield gain ghost touch.
4. **Deflective Armor:** +3 natural armor, normal nonstacking rules.
5. **Shadowmeld:** 20% concealment.
6. **Elemental Weapon:** attacks deal +1d6 chosen active elemental damage.
7. **Evasive Armor:** next successful Reflex save against a partial-on-success effect instead gives no effect, then glyph ends.
8. **Blinding Blade:** next qualifying hit forces Reflex **DC 22** or blind 1 round; glyph ends after the attempt.

Retained rank-3 advanced glyphs:

9. **Spirit Stride:** recipient may teleport **25 ft as a free action** to an unoccupied space it can see; line of sight required, line of effect not required; glyph ends after one teleport.
10. **Illusionary State:** mirror image at effective CL **11**, **1d4+3 images**; duration up to **8 rounds** and ends earlier when images are destroyed.
11. **Wind Speed:** haste benefits for **8 rounds**: one additional attack at highest BAB during a full attack, +1 attack, +1 dodge AC, +1 Reflex, +30-ft enhancement movement capped normally.

New rank-4 advanced glyphs:

12. **Death Shield:** resistance **11 to negative energy** (equal to current IL11) and +4 on saves against energy drain and negative-energy effects.
13. **Hardened Armor:** **DR 5/adamantine**.
14. **Spiritual Anchor:** target is affected as dimensional anchor for the glyph duration. If applied through the once/round post-strike free cast, Vesper must have hit that target with the strike; if cast separately, she must hit the target with a ranged touch attack. It blocks dimensional travel, not ordinary incorporeal movement through walls/floors.

sections.title: Greatsword and attack quick cards
sections.markdown:
**Actually wielded permanent weapon:** **+1 Cruel greatsword**, slashing, **19–20/x2** before any temporary Keen. A successful hit against a creature already shaken also inflicts sickened for1round. This weapon was returned/equipped31Mar and is not still at Tacitus.

- Normal full attack: **+14/+9, 2d6+8**.
- Power Attack ON at BAB 8: **+11/+6, 2d6+17** (PA -3 attack / +9 two-handed damage).
- Power Attack + qualifying Smite Good: **+18/+13, 2d6+25** on every hit.
- Smite Good special first successful hit against the qualifying Good outsider / Good dragon / Good cleric / Good paladin: **2d6+33** instead of 2d6+25 for that first successful hit only.
- Power Attack + Challenge: **+11/+6, 2d6+23**; qualifying Order attack adjustment raises these to **+13/+8**.
- PA + Smite Good + Challenge when both have actually been activated and the Order's attack condition applies: **+20/+15, 2d6+31**, special qualifying first Smite hit **2d6+39**.
- All of these require the attack to hit. No silent Swift activations or resource expenditure.

At **CL 5**, a genuinely prepared and cast **Blade Tutor's Spirit** reduces the total qualifying voluntary melee attack penalty by **2**. Power Attack's -3 becomes -1 during the spell, so plain PA profile changes to **+13/+8, 2d6+17**. It does not change weapon damage and does not eliminate unrelated penalties.

### Fiendish Boon and Vesper's Armaments (not automatic)

**Fiendish Boon, weapon form:** once/day, **standard action** to activate, lasts **8 minutes**, supplies **+2-equivalent** weapon enhancement/property budget at Antipaladin 8. Valeria chooses legal properties from what she could actually know. Prefer **Keen (+1)** and a second legal +1 property such as **Flaming (+1)** when useful; on her actually held +1 **Cruel** greatsword there is already the prerequisite +1 enhancement. Keen changes the greatsword's threat range to **17-20/x2**, never doubles it again from another nonstacking expanded-critical source. Flaming adds +1d6 fire on successful hits (not multiplied on crits), when chosen.

**Vesper's level-8 Armaments default:** one special weapon ability per empowered weapon at IL 10, **Conductive (+1)** on Valeria's greatsword, **Collision (+2)** on Styke's greatsword. Armaments cannot stack separate Conductive and Keen as two properties from the same stance; Keen comes from Valeria's separate Fiendish Boon.

**Already equipped Cruel property / conditional temporary buffs:**
- **Cruel (+1 equivalent)** is actually permanent on her equipped +1 greatsword; on a successful hit against an *already shaken* creature, inflict **sickened 1 round**.
- **Conductive** from Vesper is a separate temporary property from Armaments and is not a swift action.
- **Greater Magic Weapon** cast by Vesper at CL 8 gives +2 enhancement, replacing rather than stacking with the weapon's existing +1 enhancement.
- **Shadow** is actually enchanted on her worn Dastard full plate (+5 competence Stealth). **Corset** is actually owned and **24h wear qualification fulfilled**; once/day extra swift is READY when worn/not already used, though it still costs a real move action; Boots speed applies only while actually worn.

sections.title: Action-economy operating cards
sections.markdown:
### Normal full-attack boss opener (no Corset)

- If Vesper's **Spirit Stride glyph** is actually present on Valeria, use its **free-action** teleport to reach a visible unoccupied adjacent square within its legal range.
- **Swift:** Smite Good against a known/legitimately inferred Good major target.
- **Full-round:** full attack (**+18/+13** with PA and Smite using current unbuffed **+1 Cruel** weapon).
- Successful PA attack → **Cornugon Smash free-action demoralize** at **+26** vs suitable living foe within10ft (including Aura of Obedience), potentially worsened shaken -3 and the separate command option.
- A **later** hit with the **already equipped Cruel** weapon can sicken the already-shaken target; Conductive can channel 4d6 + Staggered cruelty without extra action if resources/property are actually available.
- **No Hurtful on this turn** because Smite already used its only normal swift action.
- Smite +8 damage applies on every qualifying hit.

### Once/day Corset boss opener — NOW ELIGIBLE after long-term wear

- **Player-confirmed established:** Valeria has worn her delivered31Mar Corset routinely for months, so its **initial 24-hour wear prerequisite is fulfilled**. Ordinary undressing or bathing does not erase a completed initial prerequisite. The once/day move-to-extra-swift is available **while currently wearing the Corset, provided its daily use has not yet been spent**; never require another24h after every change of clothes.
- Free-action Spirit Stride teleport if legitimately in place.
- **Move action** Corset activation creates one additional swift action this turn.
- **Swift:** Smite Good.
- **Standard:** Power Attack attack; hit → Cornugon Smash demoralize.
- **Other swift:** Hurtful single attack at the current full attack bonus, no iterative -5.
- Second hit may sicken via Cruel and apply Conductive Touch/Cruelty if the properties are actually active.
- Because the move action was used on the Corset, this turn **cannot also full attack**.
- The extra swift may not be used to cast spells or spell-like abilities as prohibited by the Corset.

### Later round: active Smite already running

- **Full-round:** two normal iterative attacks.
- Cornugon Smash successful demoralize → **Swift Hurtful** extra full-bonus attack.
- Smite applies damage to every successful qualifying hit, thus up to **three smite-enhanced hits** with the ordinary two iterative swings plus Hurtful.
- If Vesper's **Wind Speed** actually grants Haste, it adds one further highest-BAB attack during the full attack, for up to **four** total attacks; haste's speed bonus does not stack with Boots of Striding and Springing.

No tactical script overwrites Valeria's autonomy, knowledge, physical positioning, current resources or encounter facts.

sections.title: Antipaladin class features
sections.markdown:
### Detect Good

At will, with normal detection limits and time/concentration. Not automatic identity/alignment certainty.

### Smite Good — 3/day

- **Swift action**, target visible; bad target selection spends a use.
- Against a genuinely Good target: **CHA +7 attack**, **+8 damage per successful hit**, bypass DR, +7 deflection AC vs attacks by that target.
- Against a Good outsider, Good dragon or Good cleric/paladin: first successful hit deals **+16** Smite damage instead of +8; further successful hits deal +8.
- Smite is not an excuse to know hidden alignments without a carrier.
- Smite and Challenge each require a separate swift activation, absent a real extra-swift item effect.
- Smite lasts until that target dies or the next daily rest/regain of Smite. Its +7 deflection does not stack with other deflection: against its target, baseline AC22 + Smite7 + actually worn Dastard2 = **31** when otherwise unchanged. Dastard's +2 profane applies against a Smite OR Challenge target and is counted once if both select the same foe.

### Unholy Resilience

CHA **+7** added to all three saving throws, already in the displayed static saves.

### Aura of Despair — NEW at level 8

- **Always on** while conscious.
- All enemies within **10 ft** take **-2 penalty on ALL saving throws**.
- The aura does not independently lower AC, attacks, CMB, CMD or skill checks.
- Its penalty helps Valeria's own cruelty/aura command and legitimate saves against allied abilities.
- Apply exact enemy distance and any immunity or suppression, not a universal battlefield penalty.

### Aura of Obedience — Lord of Darkness

- 10-ft radius, +4 morale Intimidate when demoralizing living creatures.
- On successful demoralize of a living creature within 10 ft, if Valeria beats that target's demoralize DC by 10 or more, she may issue one command as the spell.
- Command Will **DC 21** = 10 + half Antipaladin level 4 + CHA 7.
- Each creature may be subject to this aura's command only once/day.
- Command is language-dependent/mind-affecting, one round, resolved on the target's next turn: Approach/Flee use its turn moving and may provoke; Drop releases held items and prevents retrieving them until its following turn; Fall makes it prone for1round but otherwise able to act; Halt prevents actions without making it helpless. An impossible next-turn command fails. This is the aura's triggered command, not an extra prepared spell or a free-form domination.
- Apply Aura of Despair -2 to the target's Will save **only while the target is within the actual 10-ft despair radius**.

### Touch of Corruption — 11/day

- Standard melee touch, does not provoke; also delivered through **Conductive** on eligible melee weapon hits when the weapon is actually imbued.
- Direct delivery: melee touch **+13** vs touch AC; **4d6** negative-energy damage to living targets, or that much healing to undead. One Touch use for direct delivery; weapon delivery below costs two. The Fortitude save is for the selected cruelty, not to halve the base Touch damage.
- Cruelty Fort save **DC 21** = 10 + half Antipaladin level 4 + CHA 7.
- Current choices:
  - **Fatigued:** ordinary lasting condition, removed normally.
  - **Staggered:** lasts **4 rounds** on a failed Fort save.
- No new cruelty selection at level 8; next at level 9.

### Conductive + Touch of Corruption — staged default interaction

- On an eligible successful greatsword attack while **Conductive** is actually present, Valeria may spend **2 of her 11 daily Touch uses** to channel one full 4d6 Touch with Fatigued or Staggered cruelty.
- **No extra standard, swift, or free action cost** beyond the hit and resource expenditure.
- One activation **per wielder per round**; maximum **five** such activations plus one remaining direct Touch from an untouched full 11-use pool, if nothing else spends uses.
- Prefer **Staggered** on meaningful living enemy targets when denying a full-round action matters; prefer Fatigued in longer pressure situations.
- Never burn Touch resources automatically on irrelevant minions merely because Conductive exists.
- **Cruel** (actually equipped) applies **sickened -2** to a target that was already shaken when struck. Sequence for a typical multi-hit round: PA first damaging hit → Cornugon Smash shakes; next eligible successful hit → Cruel sickens; Conductive Touch + Staggered cruelty is then selected on a hit. Which hit receives Conductive is an actual tactical/resource choice by the GM-controlled Valeria.
- For a living foe inside her Aura of Despair who is successfully demoralized via Air Grievances and later sickened by Cruel, the save penalty can become **-3 shaken -2 sickened -2 despair = -7**. This does **not** reduce target AC.

### Channel Negative Energy

- Standard action, **30-ft burst**, costs **2 Touch uses**.
- At effective cleric level 8: **4d6 negative energy damage** to living; Will **DC 21** for half under the current campaign engine.
- With no Selective Channeling, allies/friendly living creatures in the burst can be affected.
- Alternative undead healing per the ability's normal text.

### Plague Bringer

The accepted immunity to disease penalties/damage and ability to carry/transmit disease remains; do not turn it into immunity to unrelated poison or conditions.

sections.title: VMC Cavalier: Order of Vengeance
sections.markdown:
### Challenge — 1/day

- **Swift**; target within sight; effective Cavalier level character level -2 = **6**.
- **+6 melee damage** against challenged target.
- **-2 AC against creatures other than the challenged target**.
- Dastard armor's **+2 profane AC vs challenge target** remains.
- Against a target whose kind Valeria actually encountered in the previous 24h under the Order condition: **+2 morale attack** vs challenged target.
- Challenge and Smite are separate swift activations absent a specific real exception.

### Air Grievances — level 8 breakpoint

- On demoralize, +half effective order level using accepted campaign VMC order convention; at character level 8 this is **+4**.
- At effective order level 8, successful demoralize intensifies the shaken penalties normally suffered by the target by **1**: usual shaken -2 becomes **-3** on applicable attacks, saves, skill checks and ability checks.
- Does not increase shaken penalties on AC or automatically defeat fear immunity.

sections.title: Spellcasting
sections.markdown:

**Concentration:** **+12**  
**Save DCs:** level 1 **18**, level 2 **19**

Prepared divine spells. This sheet owns Valeria's standing daily loadout; accepted state owns explicit alternate preparations and specific copies already expended.

### Daily slot maximum at level 8 after a valid daily refresh

- Spell level 1: **3** (class base 1 + CHA25/+7 bonus 2).
- Spell level 2: **3** (class base 1 + CHA25/+7 bonus 2).

Level-7 historical capacity is already corrected to3/2. Level8 maximum3/3 is capacity, not proof of a daily refresh.

### Standard

### Standing level-8 daily preparation

- Level1: **Litany of Sloth, Doom, Bane**, one prepared copy each.
- Level2: **Blade Tutor's Spirit x2, Darkvision x1**.
- **Default application:** after every lawful daily preparation, this exact 3/3 set is Valeria's actual prepared loadout unless accepted play explicitly records a different selection. It does not require a separately narrated preparation scene, and missing prose never means she prepared nothing.
- A cast spell expends that specific prepared copy. No mid-day refill occurs without a new lawful daily preparation.
- Alternative preparations may be selected on an actual preparation day. Prepared spells are not automatically active buffs merely because they are available.

### Blade Tutor's Spirit

- Antipaladin level-2 spell; **standard action**, personal, **5 minutes** at CL 5.
- Reduces total qualifying voluntary melee attack penalties by **2** at CL 5, minimum penalty 0 (Power Attack -3 → -1).
- Does not reduce independent involuntary attack penalties and does not change damage.
- With spell actually active, Power Attack plain profile **+13/+8, 2d6+17**.

### Darkvision

- Standard, touch, **5 hours** at CL 5.
- Grants 60-ft darkvision, does not grant see-invisibility or overcome total darkness and ordinary line-of-sight limitations beyond darkvision's normal capabilities.

### Litany of Sloth

- Standing prepared level-1 spell; **swift**, V/S/DF; one creature within **35 ft** at CL5; **1 round**; Will **DC18** negates, SR yes. Language-dependent, mind-affecting compulsion: target cannot make AoOs or cast defensively. It can still cast by risking ordinary casting AoOs. While affected, it cannot be targeted by another litany spell.
- Competes directly with Smite, Challenge, and Hurtful for the swift action.

### Doom and Bane — standing prepared copies

- **Doom:** standard, V/S/DF; one living creature within **150 ft** at CL5; **5 minutes**; Will **DC18** negates, SR yes; fear/mind-affecting; applies ordinary shaken **-2**, not Air Grievances' demoralize-specific -3.
- **Bane:** standard, V/S/DF; **50-ft-radius burst centered on Valeria**, enemies only at casting; **5 minutes**; Will **DC18** negates per target, SR yes; fear/mind-affecting; **-1 attacks and -1 saves vs fear**, not -1 to all saves. Counters/dispels Bless.

### Demoralize resolution

- DC **10 + target HD + target WIS modifier**. Target within30ft must clearly see/hear Valeria; fear immunity still applies.
- Success:1round, plus1round per5 above DC. Repeated demoralization extends duration, not fear severity; further attempts against the same opponent add cumulative **+5 DC**, resetting after1hour.
- Apply actual size difference (+4 if larger/-4 if smaller) and active modifiers. Cornugon Smash changes the action to free on a damaging PA hit; Hurtful still needs its own available swift.
- Air Grievances increases this demoralize's penalties, not every unrelated source of shaken.

### Other spell preparation

- Valeria can prepare other eligible Antipaladin spells from her class list when she genuinely has a prepared slot and the normal prerequisites.
- Eagle's Splendor is not the routine second-level default because its enhancement bonus doesn't stack with her worn **+4 Charisma headband**.

sections.title: Feats / build engine
sections.markdown:
- **Power Attack:** campaign-granted, not a normal feat slot.
- **Noble Scion: Scion of War:** initiative keyed to CHA.
- **Hurtful:** swift-action extra melee attack after Valeria successfully demoralizes a melee-reachable foe; the shaken effect from that demoralization ends immediately if the Hurtful attack fails to damage it under the established campaign cache.
- **Cornugon Smash:** free-action demoralize attempt when Power Attack deals damage.
- Variant Multiclass Cavalier has consumed normal feat slots at levels 3 and 7.
- **Campaign house rule for future progression:** VMC Tactician at level 11 and Greater Tactician at level 19 are replaced by ordinary feat slots to avoid party-wide teamwork-feat state overhead. The level-15 greater order ability remains normal.
- **No new feat on level 8.**
- Current optimization direction for level 9 is **Furious Focus** rather than the older Signature Skill plan; no future feat is active before its actual level.

### Skills — four new ranks

Level 8 uses the favored-class bonus for one extra skill rank, and **keeps all four core skills maxed**:

| Skill | Ranks | Total |
|---|---:|---:|
| **Intimidate** | **8** | **+18** ordinary |
| **Diplomacy** | **8** | **+18** |
| **Sense Motive** | **8** | **+11** |
| **Stealth** | **8** | **+12** wearing actual Shadow full plate / **+12** without ACP unarmored |

Stealth **+12 with actual Shadow full plate** is net of -5 Armor Check Penalty and +5 competence Shadow property. It matters for surprise/positioning. If the armor is removed, the Shadow competence bonus disappears while the armor's -5 ACP also disappears, yielding +12 unarmored. No skill rank was traded for +1 HP.

**Demoralize** with VMC Air Grievances at level 8: ordinary Intimidate+18 **+4** = **+22**; against living creatures within Valeria's Aura of Obedience 10-ft radius, the +4 morale rider makes this **+26**. Check actual targeting, immunity, proximity and stacking on the action.

**Shadow Armor is completed and worn since15Apr.** Its +5 competence Stealth bonus counters, but does not erase, the armor's -5 Armor Check Penalty. Both are already included in the level8 Stealth+12 profile.
